hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Positive choke
function: The choke with a fixed-bore bean held in a housing under a hammer-union cap, giving a repeatable rate once the well has settled.

tabs.overview: Beans are changed by isolating the run, bleeding, and swapping the bean; the bore is stamped in 64ths.
tabs.engineering: Bean sizes per the program; 10,000 psi housing.
tabs.safety: The run must be isolated and bled before the cap comes off.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
